docs/status/console-checklist.md on main (the shop section, and the dLive and SQ re-check rows)

tests.title: Companion on the Yamaha DM7 Compact: the first run, and list B — from source, about 3 min (almost all of it over HTTP)
tests.answers: the module thread; the DM7's Companion row. Depth met by the Rivage's run the same day (the same driver), except list B, which only this desk has
tests.expect: as the Rivage, plus the one thing that is this desk's alone: the DM7 keeps two scene lists and the module can now name one. A recall into list B must carry scene_list "B"; a list the desk does not declare is refused locally with a sentence and never sent
tests.record: the module's SHA; every variable read, with its value; the connection status string; MIDI Bridge's log over the block (writes, echoes, scene events with number and name, and the 400s); Companion's log for the dylanmaudio connection
tests.safety: Every write is on SAFE9 (Input 9: no source patched, no output patched, no main assign) or is a scene recall of DMA TEST's own scenes. Nothing in DMA TEST is patched to an output and no main assign is on, so no write reaches audio on any of these desks. The block ends by recalling BASE, which puts SAFE9 and Input 8 back as found. The module never writes a level to a desk whose dB law MIDI Bridge has not measured: it refuses and says so.

steps.prompt: Page 11 'Shop check' must be imported into Companion ONCE before the first desk (not per desk): Companion -> Buttons -> Import, choose blocks/shop-check.companionconfig from the module repo, and put it on page 11. It carries 14 buttons: row 0 SAFE9's fader and mute, row 1 scenes by place, row 2 scenes by number (including list B and a list the desk hasn't got). It references the existing dylanmaudio connection by id, so the import should map it with nothing to choose. If page 11 is taken, import it anywhere and change the page number in every curl below.

steps.text: CLAUDE, the build (nothing is sent). Companion runs this module from source through a dev-module symlink — /Users/dylanmitrovich/companion-dev-modules/dylanmaudio -> /Users/dylanmitrovich/Documents/GitHub/companion-module-dylanmaudio — and the connection's moduleVersionId is "dev", so whatever is in the repo's dist/ IS the module. Check all three: (a) git -C "/Users/dylanmitrovich/Documents/GitHub/companion-module-dylanmaudio" rev-parse --short HEAD  → wants 69635f4 or any later commit on topic/avantis-yamaha, and RECORD what it reads; 69635f4 is the last commit that changed src/, so a later HEAD is docs or these blocks and changes no behaviour; (b) git -C "/Users/dylanmitrovich/Documents/GitHub/companion-module-dylanmaudio" status --short  → wants empty (an uncommitted change means dist/ and the SHA do not describe each other); (c) find "/Users/dylanmitrovich/Documents/GitHub/companion-module-dylanmaudio/dist" -name '*.js' -newer "/Users/dylanmitrovich/Documents/GitHub/companion-module-dylanmaudio/src/bridge/bridgelink.ts" | head -1  → wants a line (dist newer than src; if empty, run corepack yarn build in that checkout and nothing else). There is no package to import and no version to bump: 1.1.93 is the version on every build of this line, so the SHA is the identity. Record the SHA, not the version.

CLAUDE, reach — READ THIS BEFORE THE DESK IS BOOKED. Companion and its dev module are on THIS Mac; the Yamahas are at the MacBook station. MIDI Bridge's Client API binds 127.0.0.1 ONLY in this build and refuses anything else: dlive_midi_server.py says so in its own comment ('Binds to 127.0.0.1 only'), and shared/control_api._host_ok refuses a Host whose name is not loopback OR whose PORT is not the bridge's own (apps/midi-bridge/tests/test_client_api_http.py asserts the 403 for 'another port'). LAN mode with a token is in the spec (§4) and is NOT in this build. So there are exactly two ways to run this block, and one of them has to be chosen in advance: (a) an SSH tunnel from this Mac, forwarding the SAME port number the MacBook's bridge listens on — ssh -N -L 8765:127.0.0.1:8765 <macbook> — with this Mac's own bridge NOT holding 8765 at that moment, and Companion left pointing at 127.0.0.1:8765 (no Companion change at all); or (b) Companion and this repo installed on the MacBook. (a) is cheaper and uses the SSH link RESEARCH already keeps. A tunnel on a different local port will 403 on every request: the port in the Host header is checked. I have read this in the code but NOT measured it against a running bridge (ours was down when I wrote this) — so prove it in one command before the desk time: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -H 'Host: 127.0.0.1:9999' http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/v1/info wants 403, and the same without the -H wants 200.

CLAUDE, the desk and the gate (nothing is sent). curl -s 127.0.0.1:8765/api/v1/info and read the console block. Wants: it names the DM7 (or DM7C — the desk's own productname); verified_on_desk true (V applied in A — if it is false the look still RUNS, read-only: every write is refused with the module's own sentence, and that refusal is itself a pass for this step, recorded as 'gate shut'). V is 4529aca4 + b61e5ba8 on DEV: Yamaha driver's word after A, and it is a DIFFERENT commit from the Rivage's: a model verified is not a family verified. Also read scenes.lists here — it wants ["A", "B"]. The module reads that list from the console EVENT as well as from /info, because §8 says the block can change once the desk says its model; so if lists appear only after the model does, list B still works without a reconnect. NEW TODAY, and worth knowing if V is applied mid-session: the module re-reads this block from the bridge's SSE `console` event, so a desk that becomes verified while Companion is connected starts being driven WITHOUT a reconnect. Before today it would have refused for the rest of the session.

CLAUDE, the connection's own words (nothing is sent): curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/connections | python3 -m json.tool — the dylanmaudio row's status. Wants category "ok" on a verified desk. On an unverified one it reads "MIDI Bridge is driving a <desk>; this module version drives a dLive only": copy it word for word, it is the evidence for 'gate shut'. This is the same sentence the operator would read on Companion's Connections tab, so nobody has to look at the screen for it.

CLAUDE, the cold state, read over HTTP (nothing is sent). Run: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/name_ch1/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/name_ch8/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/fader_ch1/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/fader_ch5/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/mute_ch8/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/linked_ch11/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/partner_ch11/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/width_ch11/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/scene_current/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/scene_current_name/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/connected/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/gets_missed/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/unsupported_gets/value; Against DMA TEST (prepared-show-spec §Must 2, 6, 8, 11, 13): name_ch1 ZEBRA1, name_ch8 NARWHAL8, fader_ch1 "0.0", fader_ch5 "-20.0", mute_ch8 true, scene_current 1 (the show is stored with Scene 1 last, so it loads at BASE), connected true. scene_current_name is EXPECTED EMPTY on every desk here: the module only knows scene names from an imported dLive show file, and it does not read the bridge's scene list yet (audit §4 item 4) — empty is a pass, not a fail. linked_ch11 / partner_ch11 / width_ch11 are the stereo pair: whichever of the two forms the desk reports, and EMPTY where the desk cannot say — empty is the right answer there, never false (550c3ba). Names are 8 characters on a DM7: NARWHAL8 is exactly 8, so it should survive whole. If it comes back cut, record what it reads.

CLAUDE, the writes, over HTTP. SAFE9 (Input 9) has no source or output patched and no main assign, so none of this reaches audio. In order, 2 s apart: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/0/0/press (SAFE9 -20 dB); curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/0/1/press (0 dB); curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/0/3/press (MUTE on); curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/0/4/press (MUTE off); curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/0/2/press (-inf, as found). Read back after each: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/fader_ch9/value, curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/mute_ch9/value. Then the scene BY NUMBER — this desk numbers its scenes, so the module sends scene_number and strips the place (a place-based recall on a by_number desk is the #55 class of wrong recall): curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/2/1/press (No 2.00, ALLZERO). The proof is in the variables: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/fader_ch2/value → "0.0" and curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/mute_ch8/value → false. Then the refusal: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/2/3/press (No 9.99, which no scene has) — MIDI Bridge answers 400 desk_state, the module logs it and does NOT retry, and nothing reaches the desk. Now list B, which is why this desk is here: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/2/4/press (No 1.00 in list B, LISTB1, prepared-show-spec §Must 15). Wants: scene_list "B" in the cmd the bridge receives, one scene event naming list B, and curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/scene_current/value → 1. Then the list the desk HASN'T got: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/2/5/press (list C) — the module refuses this itself and logs "Nothing recalled: this console has no scene list \"C\". It offers \"A\" and \"B\".", with NOTHING on the wire. A list typed in the wrong case is NOT refused: "b" takes the desk's own "B", because a show button that fails on a capital is a bad trade. Then put list A back in front: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/2/0/press (No 1.00, BASE, list A — the box is empty, which means the desk's first list). The press endpoint is POST and answers 204 whether or not a button is there (checked against this Mac's Companion, 3 Nov: POST /api/location/99/9/9/press → 204, GET → 404), so a 204 proves NOTHING. The proof of every press is the variable read-back above and MIDI Bridge's log.

CLAUDE, #342: the loaded scene on CONNECT, not after a recall. Companion keeps the last value it was given across a disconnect, so reading scene_current while the link is down proves nothing — the test has to be a fresh connect with the desk NOT on scene 1. So: recall ALLZERO first (curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/2/1/press), confirm curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/scene_current/value reads 2, then make the module reconnect. Either is fine: restart MIDI Bridge (the module reconnects by itself and the connection row goes Connecting then OK), or the operator toggles the dylanmaudio connection off and on in Companion's Connections tab (about 5 seconds). Then, BEFORE pressing anything: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/scene_current/value must read 2 again — read out of the bridge's cold snapshot at GET /api/v1/state. 0, blank, or 1 is #342 unfixed. Then CLAUDE puts the desk back: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/2/0/press (BASE — No 1.00), then read curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/scene_current/value and curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/fader_ch2/value → "-5.0" and curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/mute_ch8/value → true. BASE also puts SAFE9 back, whatever the writes above left it at.

steps.question: On Companion's Connections tab, the dylanmaudio row is green/OK (not Connecting or an error)?
Press page 11's 'SAFE9 MUTE on' button: does that button go red while SAFE9 is muted, and back when you press 'MUTE off'?

steps.prompt: CO: the module's SHA; every variable read above with its value; the connection status string word for word; MIDI Bridge's log over the block (each write, each echo, each scene event with its number and name, and the 400 for 9.99); and Companion's own log for the dylanmaudio connection over the block (Settings -> Log, or ~/Library/Logs/companion). Anything the operator said.
